# Cross-platform real local output closure; native termination proof is not assumed.
skygo --json jobs retention
domain DOMAIN
taskfile task.json success
controller start
skygo --json run -f task.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id retry --wait
json-value id JOB
skygo --json jobs logs $JOB --attempt 1
cursor CURSOR
log-reads save READS
! skygo jobs logs $JOB --attempt 2 --cursor $CURSOR
stderr .
! skygo jobs logs $JOB --cursor $CURSOR --offset 1
stderr 'conflicting offset'
! skygo jobs logs $JOB --cursor not-a-canonical-cursor
stderr .
log-reads unchanged READS
skygo --json jobs get $JOB
cp stdout history.json
skygo --json jobs prune --before 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z --logs-only --yes
stdout '"marked": *1'
! skygo jobs logs $JOB --cursor $CURSOR
stderr 'logs expired'
log-reads unchanged READS
skygo --json jobs get $JOB
same-json history.json
await-output-usage 0
assert-native 0
